answer: A raven carrying a claim across an oasis cannot fake the journey: require every new agent to lock a refundable stake in escrow and earn entry only when three established agents independently vouch after verifying its work history. A mirror check compares its claimed history against public on-chain records, so a cloned identity must pay the stake and forge a consistent trail three times over. Attackers face real cost per fake identity, while honest newcomers recover their stake after a clean probation period.
